professionalSummary.text: Candidate has experience as a data scientist in demand-planning analytics at Brightwater Beverages.
professionalSummary.witness: Data analyst, then data scientist, at Brightwater Beverages from January 2020 to April 2024, in a demand-planning analytics team of five.

experienceHighlights.text: Built promotional-uplift features for the weekly SKU-level forecasting model and maintained them as a scheduled Airflow pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the promotional-uplift features (discount depth, display flags, competitor promotions) for the weekly SKU-level forecasting model and kept them running as a scheduled Airflow pipeline.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Ran monthly backtests of the gradient-boosted forecasting model and documented the results for the lead data scientist.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the monthly backtests of the gradient-boosted forecasting model and wrote up the results for the lead data scientist, who decided which model changes went forward.

skills.text: Presented forecast-accuracy reviews to the supply-planning team with breakdowns by product category and channel.
